notes: Machine-readable catalog for the installing Muse. Each entry maps to a folder under skills/. 'placeholders' lists values to ask the user for at install time; store the answers privately for that user and never commit them back to a shared copy.

skills.description: Geolocate or chronolocate a photo with tool-verified reasoning: metadata, OCR and reverse image search, a candidate board that ranks hypotheses, satellite and street-view matching, and sun/shadow math. Outputs coordinates plus an error radius with evidence.
skills.name: geo-sleuth
skills.origin: Third-party open-source skill (upstream: Oldcircle/geo-sleuth), included as installed.
skills.setup: Run python3 scripts/doctor.py inside the skill folder and follow its report; first run installs its Python dependencies (uv-managed) and may download a browser for street-view work.
skills.title: GeoSleuth photo geolocation

skills.description: Live geospatial answers from keyless public APIs: planes overhead, ISS passes, earthquakes, weather, wildfires, cyclones, rocket launches, Utah traffic cameras, satellite photos, submarine cables, radio stations, elevation, drive time.
skills.name: gods-eye
skills.origin: Original. Concept inspired by bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view (MIT); all queries hit keyless public APIs.
skills.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt inside the skill folder.
skills.title: Gods-Eye live geo lookup

skills.description: Read an ESPN fantasy hockey league through ESPN's JSON API: a logged-in browser saves the API JSON (as PDF when large), pdfjson.py recovers clean JSON, espn.py parses standings, rosters, the points race, and recent activity. Read-only.
skills.name: espn-fantasy
skills.origin: Generalized from a private original; league identifiers replaced with environment variables.
skills.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt inside the skill folder. pdfjson.py also needs pdftotext (poppler) on PATH.
skills.title: ESPN fantasy hockey reader

skills.description: FDA drug label text, NDC product details, and recall records from the free openFDA API. Reference information only, never medical advice.
skills.name: drug-info
skills.setup: None; druginfo.py uses only the Python standard library.
skills.title: openFDA drug info

skills.description: Remove the user's phone number and listings from people-search sites and data brokers, site by site, with official opt-outs and email confirmations, and a per-site report.
skills.name: people-search-scrub
skills.origin: Generalized from a private original; all personal details replaced with placeholders.
skills.setup: Ask the user for the placeholder values once; keep them in your private memory of the user, not in any shared file.
skills.title: People-search scrub

skills.description: Audit a built app screen or tool before calling it done: inventory every control, trace each save to the canonical store, verify by readback, and exercise the failure path.

skills.title: Build wiring and readback audit

skills.description: Audit app screens against the project's own measured design system: tokens, type scale, spacing grid, contrast, touch targets, motion. Measure from theme source, never eyeball.

placeholders: Project token values and owner overrides (filled in per project)

skills.title: Design system audit

Verify everything that comes back before reporting it.

skills.name: self-improvement-loop
skills.title: Self-improvement loop
